name: Boia De
bookingOpens: Online on Resy. Tables open at noon each day for dinner 30 days ahead. All availability is on Resy; its Notify list is the best way to catch same-day cancellations.
cancellation: Cancel at least 3 hours before the booking; later cancellations and no-shows are charged $20 a person. Reservations found for sale on third-party sites are cancelled.
walkIns: Some seats are kept for walk-ins, along with any cancellations, first come, first served.
groups: Indoor tables take parties of four or fewer; larger parties sit on the covered patio. Parties of seven or more are booked through the restaurant's large-party enquiry form.
children: No children's menu, but the kitchen can make simple pasta with butter or tomato sauce. Include children in the booking's party size.
duration: Tables are usually held for 1½ to 2 hours.
byob: Corkage is $45 a bottle, at most two 750ml bottles, and not for wines on the list. For parties of four or fewer, one corkage fee is waived for each bottle bought.
